variants.title: Zener regulator: 1N4733A (5.1 V) with a 1 kilohm load
variants.unknown: the line regulation of the 5.1 V regulator
variants.note: The nominal Zener voltage and the dynamic impedance Z_ZT are both printed in the 1N47xxA table.

source.title: ON Semiconductor 1N4728A-1N4764A Zener diode datasheet: 1N4733A V_Z = 5.1 V nominal, Z_ZT = 7 ohm at I_ZT = 49 mA

variants.title: Zener regulator: 1N4733A (5.1 V) with a heavier 470 ohm load
variants.unknown: the line regulation under a heavier load
variants.note: A heavier load takes more of what the series resistor passes, so R_S has to be smaller to leave the diode in breakdown. That is load regulation seen from the design side.

source.title: ON Semiconductor 1N4728A-1N4764A Zener diode datasheet: 1N4733A V_Z = 5.1 V nominal, Z_ZT = 7 ohm at I_ZT = 49 mA

variants.title: Zener regulator: 1N4735A (6.2 V) with a 1 kilohm load
variants.unknown: the line regulation of the 6.2 V regulator
variants.note: Near 6 V a Zener diode has its lowest dynamic impedance, where avalanche and Zener breakdown overlap; the datasheet's 2 ohm is the smallest in the whole series.

source.title: ON Semiconductor 1N4728A-1N4764A Zener diode datasheet: 1N4735A V_Z = 6.2 V nominal, Z_ZT = 2 ohm at I_ZT = 41 mA

variants.title: Zener regulator: 1N4740A (10 V) with a 1 kilohm load
variants.unknown: the line regulation of the 10 V regulator
variants.note: A higher Zener voltage needs a higher input before the diode breaks down at all.

source.title: ON Semiconductor 1N4728A-1N4764A Zener diode datasheet: 1N4740A V_Z = 10 V nominal, Z_ZT = 7 ohm at I_ZT = 25 mA

variants.title: Zener regulator: 1N4742A (12 V) with a 2.2 kilohm load
variants.unknown: the line regulation of the 12 V regulator
variants.note: A light load leaves plenty of current for the diode, so this is the best-behaved of the set.

source.title: ON Semiconductor 1N4728A-1N4764A Zener diode datasheet: 1N4742A V_Z = 12 V nominal, Z_ZT = 9 ohm at I_ZT = 21 mA
